title: Irreducible completely pointed modules of quantum groups of type $A$
abstract: We give a classification of all irreducible completely pointed $U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_{n+1})$ modules over a characteristic zero field in which $q$ is not a root of unity. This generalizes the classification result of Benkart, Britten and Lemire in the non quantum case. We also show that any infinite-dimensional irreducible completely pointed $U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_{n+1})$ can be obtained from some irreducible completely pointed module over the quantized Weyl algebra $A_{n+1}^q$.
